runtime_choices.host: mutating torch custom ops read their argument schema once per call (vLLM patch 0019, vllm/env_override.py), not once per argument
runtime_choices.cutlass_dsl: 4.7.1 for every consumer (vLLM, quack-kernels, B12X via patch 0002, FlashInfer, cuDNN frontend)
runtime_choices.jit_caches: driver PTX JIT cache (CUDA_CACHE_PATH, 4 GiB limit) and TileLang cache on the /cache mount, beside the B12X, CuTe DSL, FlashInfer and Triton caches
runtime_choices.jit_warmup: the dead-row variants of the draft combine and sampled/rejected-count Triton kernels are compiled at warmup (vLLM patch 0020); no kernel compiles after readiness

change_from_previous: 64 KiB host kernel and signed memory-saver DKMS on all three nodes; KV allocation rises from 2.2 to 3.5 GiB per rank and the request limit from 262144 to 524288. Container image, weights, model arithmetic and memory guards are unchanged. The 4 KiB serving profile retains the former limits.

evidence.summary: Owner-requested fleet deployment: memory-saver DKMS 0.2.0 installed and Secure Boot verified on all nodes; both CUDA checks passed on each. Missing-module doctor warnings were observed before installation and cleared afterward; actual launch rejected the 64 KiB profile on 4 KiB hosts. On 64 KiB: quality 5/5, decode 1/2/4/8 streams, real-source prefill through 262144 tokens, prefix reuse, four concurrent 485025-485026-token prompts with 4096-token outputs and 58.85 seconds of fully prefilled overlap, zero preemptions, zero swap growth, minimum MemAvailable 5.83/7.59/7.60 GiB. Near-limit retrieval passed 3/3 at 519142 tokens with prefix caching enabled. Initial short-output admission screen is retained as inconclusive on simultaneous capacity; the sustained native report is the new reference. Three decode samples per point establish a fresh baseline without a matched 4 KiB speed comparison.

hosts.secure_boot: enabled; existing enrolled DGX Fleet key signs the DKMS module
